name: ru_sci_bench_bitext_mining
description: Dataset for mining parallel Russian–foreign scientific sentence pairs from domain-specific corpora. Measures how well bitext mining and sentence-alignment methods can extract accurate parallel sentences in scientific/technical domains. Useful for evaluating translation corpus construction, cross-lingual retrieval, and downstream MT quality for scientific text.
evaluation_method: F1 (precision/recall/F1 for mined parallel sentence detection)
reputation: A specialized dataset from MSU research labs used in bitext-mining and MT research with limited but relevant adoption in the multilingual/speech community.
